item.title: GTA 6 Fans Are Hissing Mad About Dolores the Snake
item.description: After more than a decade of waiting, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. Perhaps most surprising of all, it's actually living up to the world's sky-high expectations, and players everywhere are sharing their delight and awe at the game's immaculate attention to detail on social media. But there's one group of players who aren't so thrilled about the level of realism in GTA 6 : snake owners.

item.title: Diablo 4 Officially Gets a Big Live-Service Change
item.description: Like many games built around a live-service model, Diablo 4 adds and removes a lot of content each season to keep players coming back as often as possible. However, the game’s next season will be a bit of a departure from that usual formula.

item.title: GTA 6-Like Partnership With Playstation Announced by Witcher Developer
item.description: Expect to see a lot of "plays best on PlayStation" messaging when The Witcher 4 finally gets released in 2028 (if it doesn't get delayed). Developer CD Projekt Red has announced that it has entered into a marketing deal with PlayStation that will be similar to what Sony struck with Rockstar for Grand Theft Auto 6 .

item.title: How to disable advanced trackers in GTA 6
item.description: Yes, you can disable advanced trackers in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Randy may have told you that you can't, but he didn't know about the secret advanced tracker workaround. Mind you, deactivating trackers is a bit of a cheat, since there's no "official" way to do so, but when has that ever stopped anyone?

item.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong Dev Officially Breaks Silence on Sea Of Sorrow DLC With New Showcase
item.description: Hollow Knight fans are in for a sweet Black Friday. Developer Team Cherry announced Wednesday that it's planning a "special presentation with a bunch of exciting announcements" for Friday titled Cherry Time, which promises a long-awaited update on Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow , the upcoming expansion to Silksong .

item.title: GTA 6 Owes Everything to The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
item.description: There’s a lot that a Metacritic score can’t tell you. Look up the original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on the review aggregate site and you’ll find that it has a 99 . Impressive! What that number doesn’t capture, though, is how significant the reaction to Ocarina of Time felt in 1998. The critical awe was nothing short of unprecedented at that point in video game history — I remember some publications even going as far as to award it an 11/10. The atmosphere around what was being hailed as a revolutionary game made you feel like you were experiencing history. Looking back at that moment from 2026, it’s astounding that Ocarina of Time ’s legacy actually lived up to that hype long-term.

item.title: PlayStation Plus December 2026 Free Games Lineup Officially Revealed
item.description: Sony Interactive Entertainment revealed December 2026's free Essential games for PlayStation Plus subscribers on Wednesday. There's a little something for everyone in the final month of the year: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 and 4 , Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 , and Amnesia: The Bunker will be available for subscribers at every tier of PlayStation Plus.

item.title: Mario Kart World Officially Adds New Courses, Fan Requested Features
item.description: To no one’s surprise, Mario Kart World remains the best-selling game on the Nintendo Switch 2, with an impressive 16.48 million copies sold. When you consider that there are only around 26.35 million Switch 2 owners total, that means almost 63 percent of Switch 2 players have a copy of Mario’s latest kart racer. It's a somewhat staggering figure, given that the game costs $79.99 .

item.title: 3 Reasons Why Console Prices Aren’t Going Down Anytime Soon
item.description: At this point in a console generation, system prices would have usually come down significantly, broadening install bases and making gaming more accessible. That isn’t what happened this time around. The base PlayStation 5 costs $649.99, $150 more than at launch , while the Xbox Series X is $799.99, $300 more than when it came out six years ago .

item.title: Game Awards 2026: All Game of the Year Nominees and Predictions
item.description: At this point, we have a good idea of what games will be favored by The Game Awards' voting body : A high Metacritic rating (preferably over 90) is a must; role-playing games and action-adventures are strongly favored, as are games with strong narrative elements; indie and multiplayer games struggle harder for recognition than AAA single-player adventures. We used these metrics to correctly predict last year's winner, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 , and the 2024 winner, Astro Bot . In 2025, we also predicted all six GOTY nominees and correctly called 20 other categories.
